how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application proforma. The re-advertisement calls it Annexure-III, but the form in the enclosed copy is marked Annexure-IV. It asks for your name (in block letters), father's or husband's name, date of birth, date of retirement, present post (with the date you have held it from), educational qualifications, pay scale and present pay, service and experience in various posts, the date from which you have been in continuous Government service, whether you belong to SC/ST/OBC, your correspondence and permanent addresses, and your mobile number.
Sign the form and add the date and place. Your Head of Department must then certify, with signature and stamp, that the particulars have been verified and found correct.
Send the application through proper channel to: Under Secretary (SF&TT), Ministry of Textiles, Seat Number 5307, Zone-3, 5th Floor, GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, New Delhi-110023.
The notice also gives two email addresses: [email protected] and [email protected].
Make sure the application arrives by 26 December 2026.
Up-to-date CR/APAR dossiers, or clear photocopies of your CRs/APARs for the last 5 years, attested by a Group 'A' officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India.
A statement of any major or minor penalties imposed on you in the last 10 years of service.
An Integrity Certificate or Vigilance clearance.
Applications that arrive after the closing date, come without the CR/APAR dossiers (or attested copies) and other documents, or are otherwise incomplete are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: About NTTM
content_sections.text: The National Technical Textiles Mission is run under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, and has its own Mission Directorate. The Ministry's office named in the notice is at GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, New Delhi. Both posts are with the Mission and are filled from officers on deputation.

content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: For Joint Mission Director, Level 13 applies to officers drawing the Level 12 pay scale in their parent cadre. Level 13A applies to those drawing Level 13. The pay of officers selected on deputation will be regulated by the relevant instructions of the Department of Personnel & Training, as amended from time to time. content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For both posts, the maximum age for appointment by deputation or absorption must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre or department, or who are in Level 13 or equivalent, or who are in Level 12 with three years' regular service in the grade (or equivalent) in their parent cadre or department. Qualifying (mandatory): a Masters Degree in Science/Technology, or a B Tech/BE in Textile with at least 5 years' experience in Technical Textiles. Desirable: a Ph.D in the relevant subject, and at least 3 years' experience in any Scientific/Technology Mission. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre, department or organisation, or who have three years' regular service in the grade at Level 10 or equivalent in their parent cadre, department or organisation. Required: relevant experience in implementing Government Schemes. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on deputation. The deputation period, including any time on deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before this appointment in the same or another Central Government organisation or department, lasts up to 31 March 2028. The posting is with the National Technical Textiles Mission under the Ministry of Textiles. Once an officer applies, they cannot withdraw their candidature. When forwarding the application, the forwarding authority must confirm that the officer will be relieved of their duties to join the Ministry of Textiles if selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Up-to-date CR/APAR dossiers, or clear photocopies of your CRs/APARs for the last 5 years, attested by a Group 'A' officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India. A statement of any major or minor penalties imposed on you in the last 10 years of service. An Integrity Certificate or Vigilance clearance. Cadre clearance. Applications that arrive after the closing date, come without the CR/APAR dossiers (or attested copies) and other documents, or are otherwise incomplete are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. I applied after the May 2026 advertisement. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Officers who applied against the O.M. of 21 May 2026 or the later O.M. of 10 July 2026 for these posts do not need to reapply. Their applications and the documents already sent will be considered together with the new applications.

faq.question: Q2. What is the exact last date for this re-advertisement?
faq.answer: Applications are due within 60 days of the O.M.'s issue date. Counted from the O.M. dated 27 October 2026, that is 26 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can a private-sector candidate apply?
faq.answer: No. Joint Mission Director is open only to Central Government officers. Deputy Mission Director is open to officers of the Central Government, Autonomous Bodies and Statutory Bodies. Both posts are filled only on deputation.

faq.question: Q4. Which pay level will a selected Joint Mission Director get?
faq.answer: Officers drawing Level 12 in their parent cadre get Level 13. Officers already drawing Level 13 get Level 13A.

faq.question: Q5. Is a Ph.D required for Joint Mission Director (Research & Innovation)?
faq.answer: No, a Ph.D in the relevant subject is only desirable. The required qualification is a Masters Degree in Science/Technology, or a B Tech/BE in Textile with at least 5 years' experience in Technical Textiles.

faq.question: Q6. What service does a Level 10 officer need for Deputy Mission Director?
faq.answer: Three years of regular service in the grade at Level 10 or equivalent in the parent cadre, department or organisation. You also need relevant experience in implementing Government Schemes.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the deputation last?
faq.answer: Up to 31 March 2028. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before this appointment.

faq.question: Q8. For how many years of APARs must I send copies?
faq.answer: The last 5 years, attested by a Group 'A' officer not below Under Secretary rank. You must also send a statement of any penalties from the last 10 years of service, an Integrity Certificate or Vigilance clearance, and cadre clearance.

faq.question: Q9. Can I withdraw after applying?
faq.answer: No. The notice says officers who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later.
